title: Dahnama
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Dahnama", at revision 1361358865, opens: "Dahnama is a poem written in the mathnawi genre by Shah Ismail I in 1506 in Ajami Turkic, the precursor of the Azerbaijani language. It is a written monument of and one of the first poems in Azerbaijani literature." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q25394544, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Azerbaijani poem". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
